title: Lint does not walk dashboard globalFilters[].defaultValue, so a placeholder typo surfaces only at query time
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Filing gate: out-of-scope finding from the `os-dev` of #34938 (PR #35391), filed by seat 5 (area ux-1) on the seat's word. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade p3. Pre-existing on main.

## What happens

The filter-token lint (`packages/lint/src/validate-filter-tokens.ts` and its filter walk) checks placeholders in filter conditions, but does not walk a dashboard's `globalFilters[].defaultValue` on a text filter. A misspelt placeholder there (for example `{current_iso_wek}`, or any misspelt context token) passes `os check` and fails only at query time with `FILTER_TOKEN_UNKNOWN` 400. A date filter default is already checked by the schema.

## Expected

The lint walks text-filter `defaultValue` strings and reports an unknown placeholder at authoring time with the same code and hint as a filter condition. A literal value with no braces is untouched.

## Done when

A lint pin for a misspelt placeholder in a text default, one for a known one (no finding), one for a plain literal (no finding).

Dedupe words: lint globalFilters defaultValue, dashboard filter default placeholder typo, FILTER_TOKEN_UNKNOWN authoring.
